Meta.title: Arkan — From idea to a working system
Meta.description: Arkan is a studio for building digital systems and products — from project discovery and product design to engineering, integrations, AI, and operations.

Hero.tagline: Your idea is bigger than a website.
Hero.supporting: We turn complex ideas and operations into clear, connected, scalable digital systems. From project discovery and product design to interfaces, engineering, integrations, AI, and operations — one team owns the full picture.

Atlas.title: Systems we’ve built.
Atlas.subtitle: Different industries. Different scales. One common starting point: a real business problem that needed a real system.

reframe.final: From problem to a working system — under one team’s responsibility.

whatWeBuild.title: Business systems — not a services menu

business.title: Business Systems
business.body: We build systems that connect a company’s internal operations in one place — finance, sales, inventory, approvals, reporting, and team operations. The solution may be a new system, an ops layer on an existing ERP, or integrations that turn separate tools into one organism.

operations.title: Operations Systems
operations.body: When work happens in the field, the system must be there too. We build systems for people, sites, vehicles, requests, assets, and tasks — turning daily movement into a workflow you can follow, measure, and manage.

platforms.title: Platforms & SaaS
platforms.body: One idea. Multiple roles. A product built to scale. We design roles, permissions, subscriptions, operations, and administration from the start so the platform is ready to grow.

commerce.title: Commerce
commerce.body: Selling is not just checkout. We build commerce as a full system — product, order, payment, inventory, merchant, delivery, support, and reporting — from the customer journey to back-office operations.

ai.title: AI & Automation
ai.body: We don’t add AI for its own sake. We use it when it removes a manual step, reads a document, understands an image, extracts data, assists staff, or improves a decision. AI is not the product. Sometimes it’s the part that makes the product smarter.

experiences.title: Digital Experiences
experiences.body: Sometimes the experience is the product. We build websites and digital experiences when impression, content, and interaction are part of the project’s value — with strategy, design systems, engineering, and performance.

featured.body: The interface is only what you see. Under it: intake, operations, teams, parking, dispatch, payment, management, and accounting.

invisible.title: We don’t only build what the user sees.
invisible.body: Behind every good screen sits a system the user never sees. Business rules. Permissions. Data. Processes. Integrations. Automation. Decisions. So we don’t treat a project as a set of pages. We treat it as a system. We map how work starts, how data moves, who decides, what can be automated, and what must happen when the project grows. Then we build the interface on a foundation that can run it.
invisible.footer: The interface is what you see. The system is what makes it work.

lines: You shouldn’t need six companies to build one product.
oneTeam.final: Arkan brings the whole system under one responsibility.

six.title: Six pillars. One team.
six.subtitle: Product understands the work. Experience turns complexity into clarity. Engineering turns experience into a system. Operations connects the system to reality.

evolve.title: Evolve

ControlRoom.technologyWhy: Why it was built this way

Pillars.productDesc: We turn an idea or problem into a buildable product — users, roles, processes, priorities, MVP, and evolution map.
Pillars.experienceDesc: We turn complexity into a clear experience — journeys, interfaces, states, and a design system.
Pillars.frontendDesc: We build the layer users touch — fast, responsive, accessible, and ready to grow.
Pillars.backendDesc: We build the logic behind the product: data, permissions, APIs, processes, services, and integrations.
Pillars.operationsDesc: We connect the system to how the company actually works — because great software fails if it doesn’t work on the ground.
Pillars.growthDesc: The product’s job doesn’t end at launch. We watch usage and build what the next stage needs.
Pillars.opsDesc: Connects software to real business execution.

business.title: Business Systems
business.solves: Complex operations, fragmented tools, finance/inventory/approvals without a single source of truth.
business.builds: New ERP or an ops layer on an existing ERP, internal tools, reporting, permissions.

operations.title: Operations Systems
operations.solves: Field work without visibility: people, sites, vehicles, requests, assets.
operations.builds: Dispatch, tickets, tracking, tasks, and measurable operating states.

platforms.title: Platforms & SaaS
platforms.solves: One idea that needs multiple roles, subscriptions, and scalable administration.
platforms.builds: Multi-role platforms, portals, subscriptions, and admin systems.

commerce.title: Commerce
commerce.solves: Selling disconnected from inventory, delivery, and support.
commerce.builds: A commerce system from customer journey through fulfilment and reporting.

ai.title: AI & Automation
ai.solves: Manual steps, documents, images, and slow decisions inside a real process.
ai.builds: Extraction, vision, assistants, automation, and decision support — inside the system, not as an AI agency.

experiences.title: Digital Experiences
experiences.solves: When impression, content, and interaction are part of the project’s value.
experiences.builds: Corporate sites, product experiences, portals, and design systems — with the same systems method.

evolve.title: Evolve
evolve.activity: Watch friction and build the next stage

Studio.title: The system that builds systems.
Studio.subtitle: Arkan is not a set of specialties working side by side.
Studio.body: We build the team around the project itself. Product understands the work. Design turns complexity into experience. Engineering turns experience into a system. Operations connects the system to reality. Every decision shapes the next — so we work as one team from the start.

workFirst.title: We understand the work before the technology.
workFirst.body: We don’t start by picking a framework or a dashboard look. We start by understanding the process.

systemBeforeScreens.title: We design the system before the screens.
systemBeforeScreens.body: Roles, data, and workflows come before visual detail.

whatIsNeeded.title: We build what the project needs.
whatIsNeeded.body: Not every project needs an app. Not every project needs AI.

operations.title: We think about operations from day one.
operations.body: Who will use it? Who will run it? What happens on error? How will it grow?

oneResponsibility.title: One responsibility.
oneResponsibility.body: Instead of managing multiple vendors, you work with one team accountable for the whole product.

afterLaunch.title: We stay after launch.
afterLaunch.body: Because the first version of a system is not its end.

discover.title: Understand
discover.body: We learn the operating process before writing a line of code.

architect.title: Map
architect.body: Modules, permissions, and integrations become a stable foundation.

build.title: Build
build.body: Incremental delivery with interfaces ready for daily use.

operate.title: Connect & launch
operate.body: Deploy and operate until the system works in reality.

interpretations.operations: This doesn’t look like a standalone app. It looks like a multi-role operating system that needs a central source of truth, clear workflows, different permissions, and operational/financial integration.
interpretations.business: You seem to need a business system that unifies processes, permissions, and reporting — not a set of disconnected screens.
interpretations.platform: The product looks like a multi-role platform that needs roles, subscriptions, and admin designed from day one.
interpretations.commerce: Commerce here is a system: order, payment, inventory, and fulfilment — not just a checkout page.
interpretations.ai: Intelligence here should live inside a real process — removing a manual step or improving a decision — not as a standalone AI product.
interpretations.experience: The experience is part of the project’s value, but it should sit on a clear product and operating foundation.
interpretations.default: Based on your answers, the project needs a system picture first: roles, data, and workflows before interface detail.

recommendations.operations: We recommend starting phase one by defining the core operating journey, roles, and data — then building an MVP that covers the process end to end before secondary modules.
recommendations.business: We recommend starting with a module/permissions map and one end-to-end workflow before expanding modules.
recommendations.platform: We recommend locking the role model, subscriptions, and central data source before building every role surface.
recommendations.commerce: We recommend building the order→payment→fulfilment path first, then expanding catalog, loyalty, and reporting.
recommendations.ai: We recommend picking one high-impact manual step inside an existing workflow, applying intelligence there, then measuring before expanding.
recommendations.experience: We recommend defining the business goal of the experience and the content/design system before full visual build-out.
recommendations.default: We recommend a short discovery session to turn this picture into a system map and a clear MVP.

Legal.privacyIntro: This policy explains how Arkan handles data on this website. Contact: {email}.
Legal.dataBody: We only collect what you submit via the project builder: name, email, and project configuration — to process your request and reply.
Legal.cookiesBody: We use an essential cookie (arkan_cookie_consent) for one year to store your consent choice, scoped to this site, with SameSite=Lax. We do not enable analytics or tracking before your explicit consent.
Legal.cookiesCategories: Categories: essential (always on), preferences (optional), and analytics (optional — not loaded until a vetted tool is added and you opt in).
Legal.retentionBody: We do not sell your data or share it for marketing. If a webhook is configured for form delivery, it is used only to route your request to our team over a secured channel.
Legal.rightsBody: You may request access, correction, or deletion of contact data via the email above. You can also change cookie consent anytime from the site footer or cookies page.
Legal.privacyBody: We only collect data you submit through the project builder to process your request. We do not sell your data. Contact: {email}.
Legal.termsIntro: By using the Arkan website you agree to the following terms. Project engagements are governed by a separate agreement.
Legal.termsUseBody: Content is provided to explain our services and projects. Commercial copying or republication requires written permission.
Legal.termsIpBody: The Arkan mark, copy, designs, and system descriptions are owned by or licensed to Arkan unless noted otherwise.
Legal.termsEngageBody: Submitting a blueprint does not create a contract. Scope, pricing, and timeline are defined in a written agreement before work begins.
Legal.termsLiabilityBody: We take reasonable care with marketing accuracy but do not warrant error-free materials. We are not liable for losses from relying on showcase content alone.
Legal.termsBody: Site content and project showcases are for marketing clarity. Scope, pricing, and delivery terms are defined in a separate agreement before any engagement begins.
